success_patterns: For close theorem variants, audit each branch literally: endpoints and equality cases, coefficients, index restrictions, and whether uniqueness means exactly one solution or at most one.
Preserve the full scope of the proved claim: distinguish generic from universal, almost every from every, and fixed-parameter statements from uniform ones.

patch.reasoning: The trajectories repeatedly distinguish correct answers from near-identical options by small changes in case boundaries, formula terms, or quantifiers. The current skill already covers literal parsing broadly; an explicit case-split audit adds a compact check for theorem statements encoded by detailed formulas.

edits.content: For options encoding a theorem as a case split or counting condition, audit every branch against the stated result: check endpoint inclusion, equality versus strict inequality, coefficients, index restrictions (such as odd versus all indices), and whether the condition requires exactly one solution or at most one. Do not substitute a verbal summary for these details.
